subject: Test and validate Crucible integration
description:
Phase 7 of Crucible integration: Comprehensive testing.

Testing categories:
1. Driver load test:
   - Build with crucible profile
   - Boot with --crucible cmdline
   - Verify /dev/crucible0 exists
2. Block I/O tests:
   - Write test (dd to device)
   - Read test (dd from device)
   - Integrity verification
3. Filesystem integration:
   - ZFS on Crucible (zpool create testpool /dev/crucible0)
   - EXT4 on Crucible (mount -t ext /dev/crucible0 /data)
   - Fio performance tests
4. Snapshot functionality:
   - Create/list/rollback operations
   - Data integrity after rollback
5. Resilience tests:
   - One downstairs offline (degraded mode)
   - Automatic rebuild after recovery

Create test suite:
- tests/crucible/test-driver.cc
- tests/crucible/test-io.cc
- tests/crucible/test-snapshot.cc
- tests/crucible/test-resilience.cc

Prerequisites:
- All previous Crucible tasks complete

Timeline: 2-3 weeks
